decision: Keep the opt-in scientific equipment service-zone critic. Require a separate decision about simultaneous servicing.
baseline: Prior CLI accepted the same six-layout input and returned zero equipment collisions and zero enclosure crossings in all six. It did not evaluate service allowances.
observed: All six held-out reports matched independent FreeCAD volume checks. Legacy equipment mesh bytes were preserved.
limits: User-specified axis-aligned rectangular zones. Clearance requirements themselves, rotation, worker access paths and swept motion were not measured.
next_actions: Freeze a rotation benchmark with two oblique instruments whose axis-aligned bounding boxes overlap but whose solids are disjoint. Check the result with independent solid intersections before enabling rotation.
